F1: In the new `OAuthLoginView`, the OAuth `state` is `pipeline.signature`, which is the same MD5 of view class names for every user, so the CSRF check does nothing and an attacker can inject their own authorization code into a victim's flow.
F2: Moving on when there is no `Integration` record is the existing, intended path for fresh installs whose webhook hasn't arrived yet; the change didn't add this gap, and failing closed as suggested would break normal installs.
F3: Integrations created through the pipeline get metadata replaced by `build_integration()` output, which has no `sender` because no state ever binds it, so `integration.metadata["sender"]["login"]` raises `KeyError` (a server error) once such an integration is unlinked from its org.
